notes: Source: 2024-2026 Pearl River Community College Catalog, Accounting Technology (catalog p. 111). Official four-semester sequence; online format, fall and spring start. Catalog publishes total as 60-62 hours because ENG 1113/4 and the Math/Science Elective may be taken as 4-credit versions; plan recorded at minimums per convention (ENG 1113 at 3, Math/Science Elective at 3) so the plan sums to 60. First-semester choice slots: BOT 1273 or CSC 1123; BOT 1433 or ACC 2213; BOT 1443 or ACC 2223. Elective footnotes: Technical Mathematics cannot be used as the Math/Science Elective. Asterisked (*) courses are required to earn the embedded Career Certificate; semesters 1-2 complete the Technical Certificate (45-46 hrs).
